startup: One complete context/content initialization per fresh worker process; eight warmup processes and 25 retained samples per variant, host and order. Alternate variants within each repetition; reverse their order in the reverse course. Use the existing host-cost worker initialization boundary, excluding file reads and including bundle parsing and controller creation
firstForge: One rare ring, level 21, with the explicit attr_intelligence affix and random roll quality, in a fresh generator; no setup mint. The existing protocol permits explicit forging, not fillRandom
steadyForge: 64 rare rings with explicit attr_intelligence and random roll quality, level 21, after one setup mint warms the same base pool. Inventory insertion outcomes and final snapshots remain checked; weighted random affix selection is covered separately by the inventory course and owner tests
throughput: Reuse verified host-cost workers, their timing boundaries and exact-output checks. Eight warmups and 25 retained samples in each worker; fresh logical sessions per sample
memory: Fresh native host for each variant; measure content, eight empty owners, eight identically warmed owners, after destroying owners and after host disposal. Compare incremental live bytes from content to warmed owners and report the content difference separately
summary: Median, nearest-rank p95 and full range; no sample deletion. Every applicable gate in content-plan.json must pass separately for each host and both orders
ambientCpu: Before each order, require all three two-second mean CPU observations to be at most 15%. If busy, record every observation and wait 15 seconds before checking again, at most three attempts. No work in that order starts until a complete observation passes. Refuse the order if all attempts fail; retain the incomplete run. This predeclared bounded wait changes no CPU, timing, sample-count or memory threshold and does not prove isolation.
scope: Windows desktop experimental comparison; no target-device result, architecture selection or milestone 43 acceptance
